tool.description: Native tool or ecosystem integrated by this purifier.

inputs.description: Project files required by the documented quickstart.

lockfiles.description: Lockfiles users must commit; ancillary modified files belong in project instructions.

integration.description: Available integration mechanisms, not a statement that they are interchangeable.

relock.description: Whether running lock again retains already selected versions or digests.

missing_lock.description: Wrapper behavior when no applicable lock is present.

stale_lock.description: Wrapper behavior for invalid or stale locks.

platforms.description: Documented supported Nix systems; does not imply cross-compilation support.

dependency_sources.description: Dependency repository protocols or services covered by this lock.

credentials.description: Authentication supported by the default CLI transport; builder fetcher overrides are separate.

offline_scope.description: Scope of the offline claim after prefetch, not an assertion about unrelated downloads.

offline_limits.description: Inputs or operations outside the lock and prefetch guarantee.

nix_builder.description: Nix attribute path of the project builder.

build_isolation.description: Isolation mechanism used by the Nix project builder, not native host builds.

build_outputs.description: Documented attributes exposed by the project builder result.

editor_diagnostics.description: Editor reports diagnostics using the project context.

editor_completion.description: Editor provides code completion using the project context.

editor_navigation.description: Editor resolves definitions in the project context.

editor_dependency_sources.description: Editor can retrieve source code for locked dependencies.

editor_offline.description: Editor features work without network access after prefetch.
